detectionPattern: User-controlled input concatenated into SQL query strings

fixPattern.codeTemplate: String query = "SELECT ... WHERE field = ?"; jdbcTemplate.query(query, new Object[]{ userInput });

fixRecipe: Identify user-controlled variables passed into SQL string
Bind parameters instead of injecting values
Return typed results using ORM or safe JDBC API
constraints: Requires framework support for prepared statements
User input validation in UI optional but recommended
patchNotes: Avoid string concatenation even for numeric fields
Avoid dynamic ORDER BY unless whitelisted
